Universe accessors

Source: R/accessors.R
universeAccessors.Rd

Return the parts of a RegionSetDE.universe object, the rows every region set is compared against in a competitive test. setUniverse reads the universe out of a fit or a set level result.

Usage

universeIndex(universe)

# S4 method for class 'RegionSetDE.universe'
universeIndex(universe)

universeType(universe)

# S4 method for class 'RegionSetDE.universe'
universeType(universe)

universeMatching(universe)

# S4 method for class 'RegionSetDE.universe'
universeMatching(universe)

comparisonSets(universe)

# S4 method for class 'RegionSetDE.universe'
comparisonSets(universe)

universeDiagnostics(universe)

# S4 method for class 'RegionSetDE.universe'
universeDiagnostics(universe)

universeRows(universe)

# S4 method for class 'RegionSetDE.universe'
universeRows(universe)

Arguments

universe

RegionSetDE.universe object, returned by makeSetUniverse or by setUniverse.

Value

universeIndex returns a named list with one element per region set, the positions of the rows forming its universe. universeType returns a string with the way the universe was built, for instance "otherSets", "supplied", "allRows" or "pairedSet". universeMatching returns the covariates the comparison rows were matched on, empty when they were not matched. comparisonSets returns the names of the sets the comparison rows came from. universeDiagnostics returns a data.frame with, for every set, the median width and abundance of the set and of the rows it is compared against. universeRows returns the number of rows of the object the positions refer to.

See also

makeSetUniverse, plotUniverseMatching

Author

Sebastian Gregoricchio

Examples

fit <- loadExampleData("fit", verbose = FALSE)
universe <- setUniverse(fit)

universeType(universe)
#> [1] "otherSets"
universeMatching(universe)
#> [1] "width"     "abundance"
comparisonSets(universe)
#> [1] "promoterNonCpG" "intergenic"     "geneBody"       "promoterCpG"   
lengths(universeIndex(universe))
#> promoterNonCpG     intergenic       geneBody    promoterCpG 
#>           1655           1794           1895            583 
universeDiagnostics(universe)
#>       region.set n.regions n.comparison median.width median.width.comparison
#> 1 promoterNonCpG       277         1378         1000                    1000
#> 2     intergenic       440         1354         1000                    1000
#> 3       geneBody       909          986         1000                    1000
#> 4    promoterCpG       269          314         1000                    1000
#>   median.abundance median.abundance.comparison
#> 1             3.77                        3.78
#> 2             3.44                        3.76
#> 3             3.60                        4.08
#> 4             9.81                        3.75
universeRows(universe)
#> [1] 1895
